_meta.purpose: Free-tier conditions per provider, kept as data (not hardcoded in the renderer) so limits can be updated without touching code. Limits can and do change — always keep verified_at/source_url current.

schema.provider: must match the row's `provider` field exactly
schema.requests_per_day: int or null, may grow with account credit — see unlock_condition
schema.unlock_condition: free text, e.g. how the daily quota can increase
schema.context_notes: free text — e.g. context/routing can differ from paid routes
schema.verified_at: ISO date this entry was last checked against the provider's own docs

entries.unlock_condition: El límite diario sube a 1000 req/día tras añadir al menos 10 USD en créditos a la cuenta.
entries.context_notes: El contexto/routing de una ruta ':free' puede diferir de la ruta de pago del mismo modelo.
entries.availability_notes: Disponibilidad sujeta a capacidad del proveedor gratuito subyacente; puede rotar o desaparecer sin aviso.

entries.context_notes: openrouter/free no es un modelo: selecciona automáticamente entre los modelos gratuitos compatibles disponibles en cada petición.
